title: Pandora's Star
author: Peter F. Hamilton
summary: In the twenty-fourth century, humans use wormholes to settle hundreds of worlds. When a star seems to vanish, a mission to investigate it releases a menace and sets off a crisis for the Commonwealth.
readIf: you like long, multi-character space opera with large casts and big-scale tension.
skipIf: you want a short, focused story or dislike books that end on a cliffhanger.
